Name: Confeitaria do Bolhão
Tips: Coffee + nata to go on the walk out. Opens 07:00 Sat.

Name: São Bento Station
Cost Range: 11.10 EUR/adult single, 20 EUR return to Régua
Tips: 08:45 walk from the hotel (12 min), be on the platform by 09:00 to claim seats. InterRegional has no seat reservations. Buy at cp.pt or the ticket office. Also worth 5 min for the 20,000 azulejo panels.

Name: Linha do Douro (train Porto - Régua)
Address: São Bento to Peso da Régua
Tips: 09:25 departure, ~1 h 55. Portugal's most scenic railway, running since 1887. First hour is unremarkable - from Mosteirô/Caíde the line hugs the river through terraced vineyards. SIT ON THE RIGHT outbound, left coming back.

Name: Peso da Régua
Tips: 11:20 arrival. Capital of the Alto Douro Wine Region (UNESCO). 10 min walk from the station to the riverside.

Name: Museu do Douro
Address: Rua Marquês de Pombal, 5050-282 Peso da Régua
Cost Range: ~6 EUR/adult, under 14 free - verify on site
Tips: 11:30, allow 1 hr. The story of port wine - terroir, the rabelo boats, the first demarcated wine region in the world (1756). Good audiovisuals, English captions throughout.

Name: Castas e Pratos
Address: Avenida José Vasques Osório, 5050-280 Peso da Régua
Tips: 12:45 lunch, top pick. Converted railway warehouse next to Régua station. Deep wine list, terrace views. Book by ~Aug 14.

Name: DOC Restaurant
Tips: 12:45 lunch splurge - the Douro's most celebrated dining room, wine pairing, riverside terrace. 12 km taxi from Régua (~15 EUR each way). ONLY fits if you skip the mini-cruise. Book by ~Aug 10.

Name: Cacho d'Oiro
Tips: 12:45 lunch value option - traditional, generous portions. Walk-in usually fine.

Name: Solar do Vinho do Porto
Tips: Before or after lunch - port tasting flight on the Régua waterfront.

Name: Régua - Pinhão mini-cruise
Tips: ~15:00, ~2 hrs. The Régua-Pinhão gorge is the most dramatic terraced stretch - the postcard section. Multiple operators from the Régua quay (Rota do Douro and others). BOOK by ~Wed Aug 19 for an August Saturday. Back at the quay ~17:00, 10 min walk to the station.

Name: Pinhão
Tips: Cruise turnaround point. Smaller, prettier, more vineyard-immersed than Régua - Quinta do Bomfim's walkable terraces, the azulejo-tiled station. The 09:25 train continues here (~2 h 20, 12.45 EUR single) but return connections are thinner - save Pinhão for a future overnight.

Name: Train Régua - São Bento (return)
Address: Peso da Régua to São Bento, Porto
Tips: 17:13 departure, arrives 19:05. Golden-hour light on the vineyards - LEFT side now.

Name: Gruta
Tips: ~20:30 farewell dinner - shift the reservation from 20:00 to 20:30-21:00 for Option B. Portuguese restaurants comfortably take late seatings.

Name: Escama
Tips: ~20:30 farewell dinner option. The turbot with hazelnut vinaigrette is legendary. Book by Fri Aug 14.

Name: Cobre
Tips: ~20:30 farewell dinner option on the Gaia side, bridge views from the terrace.

Name: Cais da Ribeira
Tips: 22:30 last night - the illuminated waterfront one final time. Pack, Sunday starts at 05:45.
